lesson.subtitle: Lesson 1 -- This Is Me
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Catarina | Lesson 1 -- This Is Me

listenings.text: Hi! It is Bia. I am your partner for the school project, remember? Okay, so, three things about me. I am really into music. I listen to something every single day, usually on the bus. I am not very quiet, and my friends say I talk too much. And I am super competitive, so when we play games I always want to win. What about you? Send me a message and tell me three things about you. See you on Monday!

Good morning, everyone. A quick announcement about the clubs this term. We have four. The music club meets on Tuesday, after school. The film club watches one movie every Thursday. The sports club trains on Wednesday and Friday. And the art club is open every day at lunch. You can only choose two, so think about it. Talk to your teacher before Friday. That is it. Have a good day.

items.situation: You meet a new student on the first day. Ask three questions to find out who they are.
tips: What do you do after school?

items.situation: Someone says: "I am really into photography." You do not know that word. What do you say?
tips: I do not know that word.
Can you say that again, please?

items.situation: A friend asks: "What do you do after school?" Answer, and give one reason.
You want to know if your teacher likes horror movies. Ask.
Someone asks: "Are you competitive?" Answer and give one example.
tips: Yes, I am. / No, I am not.
